newsitem.title: USA: US Congressional watchdog agency backs World Bank.
newsitem.headline: US Congressional watchdog agency backs World Bank.

text.p: A Congressional watchdog agency on Friday endorsed continued U.S. participation in the World Bank despite some problems.
"Bank operations support U.S. economic and foreign policy goals and leverage other donors' funds for doing so," the General Accounting Office said in a report.

"However, significant performance weaknesses limit the effectiveness of Bank projects, and management reforms intended to improve the quality of the Bank's portfolio have had limited impact to date," it added.
The GAO noted that the Bank itself rated more than one-third of its projects unsatisfactory because they had not met most of their major goals or contributed sufficiently to economic development.

"The Bank's rate of success is much higher in meeting physical objectives (for example, completing buildings and administering social services) than in improving market and policy conditions for economic growth," the GAO said.
It said it believes that the Bank is seeking to address the key problems facing it, but added it is too soon to say how successful the organization will be.
